name: Engineering Learning Studio Unified Quality Standard
storagePolicy: read-only test profiles; no migration, reset or upload of student drafts

commonGates.name: Source/catalog integrity
commonGates.description: Published unit identities, routes, schema, referenced resources

commonGates.name: Independent reference correctness
commonGates.description: Math invariants, GCC C11 execution, or Boolean truth table

commonGates.name: Browser interaction
commonGates.description: Student navigation, controls, output and error handling

commonGates.name: Interactive pedagogy
commonGates.description: Predict/observe/interpret, coding tasks, audio or logic feedback

commonGates.name: Progress and saved work
commonGates.description: Read-only isolated checks for localStorage backward compatibility

commonGates.name: Visual regression
commonGates.description: Screenshot matrix, overflow and display usability

commonGates.name: Evidence and approval status
commonGates.description: Machine-readable reports, failures distinguished from not-run, manual pending

numericOracle: Each course requires independent expected outputs; passing a generic browser check is not a mathematical correctness certification
